calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2025-01-01' AND calendar_date <= '2026-12-31'
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT 
    p.category,
    AVG(s.closing_value) AS avg_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week s
JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON s.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE st.region = 'West'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 11
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) as category_count
FROM fact_stock_week s
JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON s.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE st.region = 'West'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 11

SELECT 
    st.store_key,
    st.store_id,
    st.store_name,
    st.valid_from,
    st.valid_to
FROM fact_stock_week s
JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON s.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE st.region = 'West'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 11
GROUP BY st.store_key, st.store_id, st.store_name, st.valid_from, st.valid_to
ORDER BY st.store_id

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_records,
    COUNT(s.closing_value) as non_null_closing_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_closing_value
FROM fact_stock_week s
JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON s.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE st.region = 'West'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 11

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.week_ending_date) as distinct_weeks
FROM fact_stock_week s
JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON s.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE st.region = 'West'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 11

SELECT 
    p.category,
    AVG(s.closing_value) AS avg_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week s
JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON s.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE st.region = 'West'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 11
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category
